text:
keiko: quick report from crescent-v2 q5 bring-up on multilingual evals. short inline mixes of Chinese + Arabic show parenthesis and quotes swapping sides. repro and numbers below. :grimacing:

raf: paste minimal repro + model/tokenizer details

keiko: model: crescent-v2 q5-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2028. repro:
```
input: 我看到(新款)然后他说: "هل هذا متوفر؟"
expected(fp16): 我看到(新款)然后他说: "هل هذا متوفر؟"
q5 detok: 我看到)新款(然后他说: "هل هذا متوفر？"
# note: parentheses flipped around the CJK segment, i.e., opening/closing swapped
```

greg: that looks like bidi/detok ordering bug when packer aliases exist for parens. any token id diffs?

raf: ran token id compare on the samplefp16 vs q5-pack:
```
# fp16 ids: [210, 4321, 114, 5500, ...]
# q5 ids : [210, 4321, 9009, 5500, ...]  # 9009 = pack-alias for LEFT_PAREN
```

raf: alias 9009 lacks mirror-neutral tagging so bidi reconciler treats it as mirrored next to RTL span and inverts order. probable root cause.

keiko: metrics: zh->ar BLEU fp16 21.0, crescent q5 17.8 (drop ~3.2). zh->en unaffected. run: https://redwood-internal/eval/3055-crescent-q5-mix

greg: plan: triage experiments: (A) reencode without packing, (B) mark aliases mirror-neutral in bidi. run small 1k mixed sample test and post results. also check streaming detok path.

triage-bot: triage/bisect/3055556789 queued on runner-5. ETA ~15m

raf: quick local A result: disabling pack restores BLEU to 20.8 and fixes parentheses on repro set. marking alias neutral gives partial recovery (19.9).

keiko: ok will open PR for short-term tokenizer post-normalize and long-term packer change to preserve mirror metadata. adding unit tests for CJK+RTL parentheses/quotes and streaming vs batch detok. ticket ML-5077.

greg: good. add smoke to multilingual pipeline and perf check for detok changes.

triage-bot: job complete  summary: alias->bidi interaction confirmed; recommended remediation: tokenizer post-normalize + packer metadata fix.
